BL-1449 — OPERATOR_RUNTIME_BB_FILES has been retyped by hand eight times (BL-944 counted five, BL-1265 was the seventh, BL-1439 fixed the eighth on 2026-09-06), each drift a standing red until someone caught the list up: the export is computed from BL-944's own closure walk at module load, plus the declared extras, so a new load-file is in the fixture the moment it exists and the list can no longer drift
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-06 by the specifier while retiring BL-1265 (superseded by
BL-1439). Grepped first: no live ticket names the list; BL-1265's notes
said the derive-not-declare proposal was "raised to the coordinator
separately" on 2026-08-29 and nothing followed. Eight drifts is the
measurement.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. Minted by the specifier while retiring BL-1265 (superseded by BL-1439), whose own notes named this pattern as "a design that wants deriving rather than dec…
BL-1449 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1449" (or "reject BL-1449 <reason>") to act.
